page.notes: The left margin holds two notes of text, and the right margin holds the years 1261 to 1268, which are placed beside the nearest name lines. The year 1262 is printed beside a blank area and is attached to the line of Gerardus Juvenis Huginge. The years 1267 and 1268 are printed beside a blank area and are attached to the last name line. The opening capitalised line is treated as a level 2 heading. The word "Ado-ardianum" keeps the printed hyphen at the line end. The name "Mauriffinc" and "Sickinc" are as read from the scan; the final letters are slightly unclear.
